title: Organic Discovery and Evidence Content Loop
purpose: Improve organic discovery with search-intent pages, public Benchmark Lab evidence pages, outcome tutorials, GitHub landing polish, and an evidence-backed content loop.
problem: Deep architecture is hard to discover. Locaily needs outcome-shaped pages and evidence content, not one giant architecture README only.

included: GitHub landing polish: topics, description guidance, demo GIF/screenshots placeholders, Run the demo command, release badge, OS support, good first issue
At least 3 search-intent pages or docs landing sections (e.g. local AI orchestration, Ollama workflow automation, Lighthouse for coding agents)
Publish clean HTML or docs pages from selected Benchmark Lab / qualification evidence
At least 2 outcome tutorials ending in visible artifacts
Template for evidence → short report → lesson → searchable page → social post
excluded: Full marketing site redesign outside repo docs
Claiming benchmark results beyond stored evidence

acceptanceCriteria.description: README/GitHub landing includes demo command, screenshots or GIF slot, topics list, and first-issue pointer
At least 3 intent-focused pages exist and link to a runnable example
At least 1 public evidence-derived comparison/qualification page published from real records
At least 2 tutorials end with a visible artifact path
Evidence content loop template checked into docs
